blaze_face_short_range.license_evidence: MediaPipe BlazeFace Model Card (Short Range), 2021-06-09: 'LICENSED UNDER Apache License, Version 2.0'. https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/MediaPipe%20BlazeFace%20Model%20Card%20(Short%20Range).pdf
blaze_face_short_range.training_data: Model card: trained and evaluated on consented images captured with smartphone cameras via a mobile AR application.
blaze_face_short_range.intended_use_caveat: Model card lists 'any form of surveillance or identity recognition' and life-critical decisions as out of scope (intended-use statement, not a licence term). Results are review aids only.

efficientdet_lite0.license_evidence: Kaggle Models API, tensorflow/efficientdet/tfLite/lite0-detection-metadata version 1: "licenseName": "Apache 2.0" (retrieved 2026-10-23 from https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/models/tensorflow/efficientdet/tfLite/lite0-detection-metadata/get). Source code: google/automl (Apache-2.0).
efficientdet_lite0.training_data: COCO 2017 (annotations CC BY 4.0; images are Flickr photos under their own licences). The model licence does not resolve dataset terms: open item for legal review, see docs/AI_PROCTORING.md.
efficientdet_lite0.intended_use_caveat: Generic COCO detector: 'cell phone' recall is limited (4 of 5 real phone photos found in testing) and other rectangular objects can be mistaken for phones. Results are review aids only.

face_recognition_sface.license_evidence: OpenCV Zoo models/face_recognition_sface/LICENSE: 'Apache License, Version 2.0' (retrieved 2026-10-27 from https://github.com/opencv/opencv_zoo/tree/main/models/face_recognition_sface). The Hugging Face mirror opencv/face_recognition_sface is published by the OpenCV organisation; its LFS SHA-256 equals the pinned hash.
face_recognition_sface.training_data: Model card: MobileFaceNet trained with the SFace loss (Zhong et al., arXiv:2205.12010); the card does not name the training set. The SFace paper reports experiments on research face datasets (CASIA-WebFace / MS1M family) whose terms restrict use; the provenance of these exact weights is unconfirmed: open item for legal review before production.
face_recognition_sface.intended_use_caveat: 1:1 face verification feature. Accuracy varies with lighting, pose, age and demographics and has not been independently validated here. A mismatch is a review signal, never proof that another person sat the exam.
